activity.notes: Gregory I served as Bishop of Rome and pope from 590 to 604 while Rome remained within the Byzantine imperial political order. Oxford notes that he recognized Byzantine imperial sovereignty and at times acted independently of emperor and exarchs while administering Rome amid Lombard pressure. ATLAS therefore binds his papal activity to the higher-order Byzantine Empire with active_in, not to the later Papal States and not as service to the Byzantine government.
